description: Source code for CUDA Sanitizer module in PyTorch, providing tools for detecting synchronization errors and data races between CUDA kernels on different streams.

classes.name: Access
classes.description: Stores information about a single tensor access by a kernel, including type, sequence number, stream, operator schema, aliases, output status, and stack trace.

classes.name: SynchronizationError
classes.description: Base class for errors detected by CUDA Sanitizer.

classes.name: UnsynchronizedAccessError
classes.description: Represents a data race error with details about conflicting accesses and stack traces.

classes.name: CUDASanitizerErrors
classes.description: Wrapper for multiple synchronization errors detected during sanitization.

classes.name: TensorInfo
classes.description: Stores info about a tensor's allocation stack trace, recent reads, and last write.

classes.name: _TensorsAccessed
classes.description: Manages tensor access info, including creation, deletion, and access updates.

classes.name: StreamSynchronizations
classes.description: Tracks synchronization states between streams and events.

classes.name: EventHandler
classes.description: Analyzes trace for synchronization errors, managing tensor accesses and stream/event states.

classes.name: CUDASanitizerDispatchMode
classes.description: Custom dispatch mode that hooks into CUDA events, streams, and memory operations for sanitization.

classes.name: CUDASanitizer
classes.description: Manages the lifecycle of the CUDA sanitizer dispatch mode, enabling and disabling it.

methods.name: enable_cuda_sanitizer
methods.description: Enables the CUDA Sanitizer to detect synchronization errors during CUDA kernel execution.
